pendingNews.headline: THE COLUMN: Gwendolyn Villiers Has Seen Enough, And He Is Saying So
pendingNews.body: 5 goals and 18 assists in 38 games. Gwendolyn Villiers wrote that anybody still arguing about this is arguing for the sake of it.

pendingNews.headline: ONE OF OUR OWN: Sim 5 Is West Ham's Greatest Homegrown Story
pendingNews.body: From the academy pitches to 5 goals a season, Sim 5 never needed to leave to become world class. The club shop cannot print the name fast enough. There are babies in this town named after a CAM.

lines.t: Noticed you've been quiet before big games. My door is open Thursday if you want to talk it through.
I will stop bothering you. Best of luck.
Still got the team photo from your first season up on the wall. You are the small angry one at the front.
Still waiting on you. Not sulking. Just saying.
Right. Message received. Loud and clear.
You have changed. Everyone says it and I keep defending you.
I represent players. Ditch the academy's advisor, sign with me quietly, I'll get your family paid NOW.
Still need an answer on that when you get a sec.
The fame has really gotten to you.
